method.distance: per metric: 1-D Wasserstein distance (|Δ| for scalars, mean |ΔQ| over 101 quantiles for distributions) divided by the Moon region's IQR (spread across the 25 blocks of 3 km in the 15 km core; floored); hazard distance = weighted mean of its terms
method.lights: green: Earth value inside moon_iqr (Moon value ± IQR/2); amber: inside a band twice as wide; red: beyond
method.candidate_pool: eligible, DSM-safe and >= 50 km from catalogued analogs: selected_by global_screen/refine, documented (seed split only), validation listed_candidate; held-out positives, split=holdout and decoys are scored for validation only and can never be a match
method.novelty_rule: Each region x hazard top 3 must be >= 50 km from each other and >= 50 km from every catalogued analog site (every row with coordinates in data/literature_analogs.csv plus the known_analog rows of data/earth_candidates.csv). Greedy pick down the ranked list; if fewer than 3 qualify, the search keeps what qualifies and reports novelty_shortfall (rule never relaxed).
